notes: Final amendment (Amendment No. 1) reporting results. Maximum sought is the lesser of (i) 9,859,801 shares (5% of the weighted average shares outstanding for calendar 2021, not of shares outstanding at the offer) and (ii) a distribution-reinvestment-plan-proceeds-based number not stated as a count; size_shares and size_pct_outstanding give the stated cap (i). price_pct_nav=100 because the price is stated as 'an amount equal to the net asset value per Share', not as a percent. Commencement taken from the Offer to Purchase date (March 31, 2022), also the date the Schedule TO was filed. Proration factor stated as 'Approximately 4.7%'. Conditions are not stated in this amendment. The filing does not say whether the company is listed or an interval/tender-offer fund; fund_type and trigger_origin (periodic liquidity tenders funded by DRIP proceeds) are read from the offer's structure. No ticker is printed.
